leadText:
Darley (Japanese: ガンモ Ganmo) is a character of the day who appeared in Aiming for the Top Floor!. He is one of the ninjas in the Kantonian Gym, and is in charge of its second floor.

Darley presented and with a banquet of food, which they proceeded to enjoy. After they finished it, Darley declared that they had all completed his task. was surprised that all they had to do was eat, but he explained the task was for participants to truly appreciate all that Malie City has to offer.

==Trivia==
